# version fingerprint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:versionFingerprint`](gmeow-versionFingerprint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/versionFingerprint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/versions`](../../slices/versions.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A content fingerprint of the versioned entity — a hash, SWHID, content digest, or semantic identifier. Broader than [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md) (which is byte-exact and domain [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md), typically [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) or [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md)): [`versionFingerprint`](gmeow-versionFingerprint.md) covers semantic fingerprints where exact bytes are not the identity criterion (e.g. a normalized form, a canonicalized serialization). Non-functional: a single entity may carry several fingerprints under different algorithms or schemes.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to fingerprint a versioned entity where the identity criterion is semantic rather than byte-exact — a SWHID, a normalized-form hash, a canonicalized-serialization digest.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a byte-exact digest of a creative-work manifestation or item (use [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md)) and avoid assuming one fingerprint per entity; several algorithms or schemes may coexist, so it is non-functional.

### How to use

- Attach one literal per algorithm/scheme to the versioned [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); record byte-exact identity separately with [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md) where that is the criterion.

### Examples

- ex:v2 [`gmeow:versionFingerprint`](gmeow-versionFingerprint.md) "swh:1:rev:abc123".
